summary: GATX Corporation filed an 8-K on July 1, 2026, disclosing the exercise of the first call option under a pre-existing Call Option Agreement to acquire an additional interest in GABX Leasing Holding LLC (Blocker), increasing its indirect interest in the GABX Leasing LLC joint venture from 30% to approximately 33.535%. The remaining ~66.465% is held by Brookfield Infrastructure partners. Concurrently, the Blocker LLC agreement was amended and restated, granting GATX joint approval rights over fundamental actions and admitting it as a member while Brookfield remains Managing Member. The Call Option Agreement was previously filed on January 5, 2026. This is a contractual step-up, not a transformative event—no price, premium, or tender terms disclosed. Watch for subsequent call exercises per the option agreement schedule.
